name: ACB

amountMinVnd.note: Not stated on the product page (re-read 2026-11-03), nor in the ACB ONE registration guide (image-only PDF, not read) or the account T&C (QF-A1.66/KHCN-07.24), which only says an overdraft limit can be linked to a payment account.

amountMaxVnd.note: Page does not state the limit; it only says 'Quản lý hạn mức thấu chi hoàn toàn trực tuyến'. Old figures exist but are for other ACB overdrafts and are not used: SGGP 17/07/2007 says up to 1 tỷ (depends on the type, incl. secured), VnExpress 21/06/2012 says salary-account overdraft up to 100 triệu.

termMaxMonths.note: Page: 'Thời hạn vay lên đến 12 tháng' and 'Thời hạn trả vốn lên đến 12 tháng'. Page date 09/07/2026 is the date ACB shows beside the product on the category page (https://acb.com.vn/vay-von/vay-tieu-dung) and the page's own CMS updated_at.

minPercent.note: Page: 'Lãi suất chỉ từ 0.06%/ngày theo số ngày thực tế sử dụng'. 'Chỉ từ' = starting rate, not the rate a borrower gets. Stored as quoted (per day); a simple x365 is about 21.9%/year but the page gives no yearly figure and does not say how interest compounds. Interest is paid on the 15th of each month. 100% interest waiver if the limit is used and repaid the same day before 17:00 Mon-Fri / 12:00 Sat. No upper rate or rate table found anywhere on acb.com.vn.

basis.note: Page says interest is charged on actual days used but does not say flat or reducing, nor on which balance.

rates.segment: Lãi suất cho vay bình quân toàn ACB kỳ tháng 09/2026 (không phải lãi suất của sản phẩm này)

minPercent.note: Page: 'lãi suất bình quân của các khoản vay mới giải ngân trong kỳ tháng 09/2026'; ACB says it is 'không phải là lãi suất áp dụng đối với từng khoản vay cụ thể'. Mostly secured and business loans; do not use as a consumer rate.

amortization.note: Overdraft limit with interest paid on the 15th of each month; principal due within the term. Schedule not detailed.

fixedVnd.note: Page: 'Không phí quản lý thấu chi'. No overdraft fee schedule (biểu phí) exists on acb.com.vn: /bieu-mau-bieu-phi and /bieu-mau1 show no documents. Early-repayment, account or other fees are not published; absence is not proof of zero.

maxAge.note: Page: 'tuổi tối đa bao gồm thời hạn cho vay'.

documents.note: Not stated; registration is done in the ACB ONE app.

existingCustomerRequired.note: Page requires an ACB ONE account (so an ACB customer). Salary through ACB is not stated.

value: Có tài khoản đăng nhập ACB ONE
Đáp ứng điều kiện tín dụng của ACB từng thời kỳ

eligibility.notes: Interest-free (100%) if the limit is used and repaid the same day before 17:00 Mon-Fri (12:00 Saturday). Interest paid on the 15th monthly. 'Không cần tài sản đảm bảo'. Registration in ACB ONE: Tài khoản > 'Đăng ký hạn mức thấu chi' > enter information > confirm contract (about 2 minutes). The contract itself is not published, so documents, income and the limit approved are unknown. Page read 2026-11-03 both as text and as raw HTML.

textVi.note: Not stated on the page. Searched 2026-11-03: product page, /vay-von/vay-tieu-dung, /bieu-mau-bieu-phi, /bieu-mau1 (no documents), sitemap (1,627 URLs, no overdraft contract/T&C), account T&C (QF-A1.66/KHCN-07.24: no overdraft pricing or penalty), credit-card fee PDFs (card only).

products.excludeReason: ACB chỉ công bố mức 'từ 0,06%/ngày' (lãi suất khởi điểm), không có khoảng lãi suất thực tế, không rõ cách tính, hạn mức và phí khác, nên chưa so sánh được.
products.notes: Only a starting daily rate is published (updated 09/07/2026). No limit, upper rate, late penalty, insurance or contract. Not rankable.

borrowerNotes.vi: 0,06%/ngày tương đương khoảng 21,9%/năm nếu tính 365 ngày. Đây là phép tính của chúng tôi, ngân hàng không ghi con số này.
borrowerNotes.en: 0.06% a day is about 21.9% a year over 365 days. This is our calculation, not a figure the bank states.

researchNotes: RESEARCH 2026-11-03 (deep dive). 1) Licence: 'acb' is on data/licensed-institutions.json (bank). 2) Is there an unsecured salary or consumer cash loan? Not on any current official page. The official category 'Vay tiêu dùng' (https://acb.com.vn/vay-von/vay-tieu-dung) lists four items: Thấu chi tiêu dùng Online (09/07/2026, unsecured), Vay tiêu dùng thế chấp (21/03/2024), Vay cầm cố thẻ tiết kiệm, giấy tờ có giá (09/10/2024) and Vay mua xe ô tô (21/03/2024). /vay-von also lists Vay mua nhà đất, xây sửa nhà, Giảm lãi vay tự động and business loans. /vay-von/vay-von-qua-doi-tac ('Vay vốn qua đối tác') is a title page with no partners, products or figures. The sitemap (https://acb.com.vn/sitemap-0.xml, 1,627 URLs, read 2026-11-03) has no tín chấp / salary loan URL; /vay-von/cho-vay says 'Không có sản phẩm'. Guessed URLs (vay-tin-chap, vay-tieu-dung-linh-hoat...) return the site's soft-404 page (HTTP 200, 'Không tìm thấy trang'). 3) One trace of an older product: ACB's own library article https://acb.com.vn/thu-vien/vi-sao-cho-vay-tieu-dung-tai-ngan-hang-ngay-cang-thu-hut-gioi-tre (CMS metadata: published 2023-12-27, updated 2024-03-11; no date visible on the page) describes 'Vay tiêu dùng linh hoạt': unsecured, for salaried people aged 25-55 who receive salary through an ACB account, minimum salary 3 triệu/month, 10 triệu to 500 triệu, 6 to 60 months, interest on the declining balance, documents: ID + labour contract or payslip, no rate figure. Not recorded as a product: it is not on any current product page, the article is older than 12 months and calls itself general information. Related library articles (4-goi-vay-tieu-dung-pho-bien-nhat-hien-nay: secured loans, 'chỉ từ 0,75%/tháng' on declining balance for consumer loans generally, undated; lai-suat-cho-vay-tieu-dung-hien-nay-la-bao-nhieu: market range 12-23%, no ACB rate) give no usable unsecured rate. Old press: VnExpress 21/06/2012 (500 triệu / 60 months, interest fixed on total debt) and SGGP 17/07/2007 are obsolete and not used. 4) The 17.9%/year lead: no official ACB source supports it. It was not found on cellphones.com.vn, topi.vn, muaban.net or mytour.vn lender pages (checked 2026-11-03); those sites quote other, mutually inconsistent figures (11-12% / 20-22% / 21-23% / 22%, some flat some reducing, undated). Not recorded. 5) Overdraft (Thấu chi tiêu dùng Online): the only published rate is 'chỉ từ 0.06%/ngày theo số ngày thực tế sử dụng', stored as an advertised floor. Limit, upper rate, late penalty, insurance, early repayment fee and contract are not published. Searched: product page (text and raw HTML), category page, /lai-suat-cho-vay (bank-wide average only: 9,53%/năm for new loans in tháng 09/2026), /bieu-mau-bieu-phi and /bieu-mau1 (both show no documents), sitemap, the account/card T&C (QF-A1.66/KHCN-07.24; mentions overdraft only as a limit linked to a payment account), ACB ONE Google Play listing (mentions 'Giải ngân khoản vay' and 'Trả nợ tiền vay', no loan product, rate or overdraft; its reviews carry loan-ad spam, ignored). The registration guide PDF linked from the page ('Hướng dẫn thao tác đăng ký trên ACB ONE') is image-only, so its text could not be read. 6) Credit-card fee PDF (https://acb.com.vn/acbwebsite/files/Bieu_phi_the_tin_dung.pdf, effective 01/01/2026, read in full 2026-11-03 with pdftotext -raw): describes card products only, no loan. ACB Express (domestic credit card): in-term rate 20%/năm for salary-account holders and VIPs issued since 01/03/2021, 10% for ACB staff, 25% on cards issued before 01/03/2021 (other customers no longer issued); overdue interest 150% of the in-term rate; card-to-instalment conversion fee at non-partner merchants 1,99% (3 months) to 7,99% (12 months), free at partner merchants; cash-advance instalment 1% + 0,75% per statement on the original amount; early termination 2%. Premium cards 25-30%/năm. A second card fee PDF effective 10/04/2026 (Bieu_phi_the_tin_dung_07_04_26.pdf) covers other cards. Cards are out of MVP ranking, so none is recorded. 7) 'Giảm lãi vay tự động' (https://acb.com.vn/vay-von/giam-lai-vay-tu-dong) is a rate-reduction programme for existing borrowers; no percentages published. 8) Surprising: ACB's main page for salaried workers lists no unsecured term loan at all; its only unsecured consumer credit is the overdraft in ACB ONE, which requires an existing ACB ONE login. www.acb.com.vn legacy portal returned 503 earlier.
